verdict.rationale: cubic lets teams define "custom agents", which are review rules enforcing org-specific best practices, configured in cubic.yaml and inheritable via an org-wide cubic-config repo. It can also learn patterns from senior reviewers' past PR comments. This extends the agent with specialized review behavior, but only within code review, not as general-purpose skills or tools. Missing for 10: a general skill/plugin mechanism beyond review rules, custom tools or actions the agent can execute, detailed schema docs for custom agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
